name: Relay Image Saver
description: Save the AI images from your own ChatGPT page with clean file names, or as one ZIP. Runs in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob: https://*.oaiusercontent.com https://chatgpt.com https://chat.openai.com; connect-src 'self' https://chatgpt.com https://chat.openai.com https://*.oaiusercontent.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; worker-src 'none'

quick-save.description: Save every image on the current ChatGPT page with your last settings
